name: Scope API
description: REST surface for ELM, firm-OS, and external-system integration with Scope. Matter sync, dispatch creation and award, audit log, LEDES + audit exports, carrier feed, vendor roster, read/intelligence insights, and outbound webhooks. Every endpoint is tenant-scoped, rate-limited, and audit-logged. Auth: a PAT, an OAuth access token (authorization_code), or a partner client_credentials token. A partner token additionally sends X-Scope-On-Behalf-Of: <firm_org_id> and is gated by an explicit firm grant.
